privacy.title: Политика конфиденциальности
privacy.subtitle: Как сайт PEOPLE Blockchain обрабатывает данные при просмотре, входе и использовании партнёрских инструментов.
privacy.contactBody: For privacy questions, access or correction requests, or account deletion, email {email}. We respond using that address for this site.

blocks.title: Who this policy is for
body: This policy describes the website at www.peopleblockchain.network (the "site"), operated by the People Blockchain project operators ("we", "us"). It applies when you visit public pages, use the in-browser wallet, explore the test network, or sign in to the partner portal.
This policy does not replace the public nature of blockchain data. On-chain activity on the PEOPLE Blockchain test network is visible to anyone and cannot be made private after it is confirmed.

blocks.title: Information we collect
body: Partner sign-in with Google: if you choose "Continue with Google", Google OAuth shares your name, email address, and profile picture with us so we can create or identify your account.
Partner sign-in with email: if you request a magic link, we collect the email address you type, send a one-time sign-in link through Resend, and store verification tokens needed to complete sign-in.

Account and partner records in our database (hosted on Neon Postgres): your user id, linked OAuth account fields (provider, provider account id, and tokens returned by the provider where applicable), session records, email verification timestamps, partner referral code, who referred you (if recorded at registration), wallet public address and public key after you bind a wallet, and timestamps such as when the partner profile was created or the wallet was bound.

Referral attribution: if you arrive with a referral link or code, we may store a referral cookie (people_partner_ref) for up to 30 days so we can attach you to the inviting partner when you first sign in, using a first-wins rule.

Server logs and security data: like most websites, our host (Vercel) may process connection metadata needed to deliver pages and protect the service. We do not run third-party advertising or analytics scripts on this site in the application code.

blocks.title: Information stored only in your browser
body: Non-custodial wallets: wallet keys are created and encrypted in your browser. Encrypted private keys and optional mnemonics are saved in localStorage under the key ppl-web-wallets. Language (people_lang) and colour theme (people_theme) preferences are also stored in localStorage.

We never receive your wallet private keys, seed phrases, or wallet encryption password. Only public addresses and public keys are sent to our servers when you choose to bind a wallet to your partner profile.

blocks.title: Cookies and similar technologies
body: Sign-in session: when you use the partner portal, Auth.js / NextAuth sets cookies needed to keep you signed in and to protect sign-in (for example session and CSRF-related cookies). These are used for authentication and security, not for advertising.
Referral cookie: people_partner_ref remembers an invite code for up to 30 days when you have not already been attributed.

Мы не используем SMS для входа. Верификация через Telegram: если вы выбираете её, вы один раз передаёте номер телефона нашему боту в Telegram; мы храним его, чтобы обеспечить один аккаунт на человека.

blocks.title: How we use information
body: We use the data above to operate the site, authenticate partners, send magic-link emails you request, display your partner cabinet, attribute referrals at registration, verify wallet ownership when you bind an address, and read public test-network data for balances you choose to view.
We do not sell your personal information.

blocks.title: Blockchain and test network
body: PEOPLE Blockchain is offered as a public test network (beta). Transactions, addresses, and balances on the chain are public and permanent once included. Test PPL has no monetary value and is not a promise of future value or income. Покупки в продаже PPL — публичные транзакции в сети Base.
Deleting your website account does not remove or change on-chain history.

blocks.title: Service providers
body: We rely on service providers that process data on our behalf: Vercel (hosting), Neon (database), Google (optional OAuth sign-in), and Resend (transactional email for magic links). They handle data according to their own terms and our instructions for operating the site. Human Passport и Telegram (верификация), LI.FI (виджет обмена и моста на /buy) и WalletConnect (подключение кошелька).

blocks.title: Retention
body: We keep partner and account data while your account exists or as needed to operate the service and meet legal obligations. Magic-link and verification tokens expire automatically. Referral cookies expire after 30 days unless cleared earlier.

blocks.title: Your rights
body: Depending on where you live, you may have rights to access, correct, or delete personal data we hold about you.
You can ask us for a copy of the account data we store or ask us to correct inaccurate profile information by emailing {email}.

You can ask us to delete your account. When we delete your user record from our database, related rows (account links, sessions, verification tokens, and partner profile) are removed through database cascade rules. We cannot delete public blockchain data tied to your wallet addresses.
You can clear browser localStorage at any time to remove wallets and preferences stored on your device. That does not delete server-side account data.

blocks.title: Children
body: The site is not directed at children under 16, and we do not knowingly collect personal data from children.

blocks.title: Changes
body: We may update this policy. We will post the new version on this page and change the effective date above.

terms.title: Условия использования
terms.subtitle: Правила использования сайта PEOPLE Blockchain и партнёрских инструментов, пока сеть в тесте/beta.

blocks.title: Agreement
body: By using www.peopleblockchain.network you agree to these Terms of Service and our Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, do not use the site.
The site is operated by the People Blockchain project operators. We do not state a registered company name or office address in these terms.

blocks.title: Test network and beta status
body: PEOPLE Blockchain is provided as a test / beta network. Features may change, break, or be withdrawn without notice. The site and network are provided "as is" and "as available".
Сеть People пока тестовая. Продажа PPL — отдельная: она идёт в мейннете Base за реальные USDC или USDT.

blocks.title: Публичная продажа PPL
body: Параметры продажи (формула кривой, траектория цены, лимиты и цель graduation) опубликованы на странице /buy. Покупка недоступна, пока не опубликован контракт продажи; подключение кошелька ни к чему не обязывает.
KYC для покупки не требуется. Для продажи обратно в резерв нужна проверка, что вы человек (Human Passport или Telegram), — это не KYC.

Продажа идёт до распродажи (кривая закрывается при сборе $4M) или 24 месяца с момента открытия — что наступит раньше. Продлений нет. Непроданные PPL уходят в Community Pool. Возвратов нет: каждая покупка окончательна.
Срок продажи, формула цены и лимиты после открытия продажи не меняются.

Продажа обратно в резерв — не возврат денег: Продажа обратно в резерв — только для верифицированных пользователей. Каждую партию можно продать после 30 дней удержания по цене кривой на момент продажи. Общий лимит — 2% резерва в сутки на всех и $2 000 в сутки на человека. Комиссия 1,5% (3%, если за день уже продано обратно больше 1% резерва). Закрывается после выпуска в пул (graduation). Выплата — в USDC в сети Base.
Ничто на этом сайте не является офертой или обещанием продать PPL там, где продажа ограничена; участие может быть недоступно в вашей юрисдикции.

blocks.title: No investment or financial advice
body: Nothing on this site is investment, tax, or legal advice. We do not promise profits, returns, token price, listing, or income of any kind.

Test PPL and other test-network assets have no monetary value. Holding or earning test tokens does not entitle you to mainnet tokens, money, or future allocations unless we publish a separate, binding program—and none is promised here.

blocks.title: Your wallet and keys
body: Wallets on this site are non-custodial: you create and control keys in your browser. You are solely responsible for safeguarding seed phrases, private keys, and passwords. If you lose them, we cannot recover funds or access for you.
Never share secrets with anyone claiming to be support. We will never ask for your seed phrase or private key.

blocks.title: Acceptable use
body: You agree not to misuse the site or network: no unlawful activity, harassment, fraud, attempts to break security, denial-of-service attacks, scraping that harms service availability, or interference with other users or validators.
You are responsible for activity performed with your signed-in account and with wallets you control.

blocks.title: Partner program and referrals
body: The partner portal lets you sign in, receive a referral code and invite link, see direct (L1) and second-line (L2) partners you referred in our database, and bind a wallet address to view public on-chain Growth-related figures.

Referral relationships are stored off-chain for the website when you register with someone's invite link, subject to depth limits (no third-line referrals in the partner graph). On-chain Growth fee sharing follows protocol rules (including L1 70% / L2 30% of the Growth reward budget where applicable on the network). Displayed accruals depend on live network data and may be unavailable if a node is not connected.
Referral and Growth mechanics do not guarantee referrals, payouts, partners, or income. Results depend on real network activity, eligibility rules, and protocol parameters that can change.

blocks.title: Third-party services
body: Вход может использовать Google или доставку писем через Resend. Оплата из других сетей идёт через LI.FI (обмен и мост); подключение кошелька — через WalletConnect; верификация — через Human Passport или Telegram. Использование этих сервисов регулируется и их условиями.

blocks.title: Disclaimers
body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, we disclaim warranties of merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose, and non-infringement. We are not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from use of the site or test network, including loss of tokens, keys, or data.
Some jurisdictions do not allow certain limitations; in those cases our liability is limited to the maximum allowed by law.

blocks.title: Changes
body: We may change these terms. Continued use after the effective date of an update means you accept the revised terms. Material changes will be posted on this page.
